name: Civil rights
description: Federal protections against discrimination and for voting rights.

questions.support_means: Favors a federal law prohibiting discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in those areas.
questions.text: Should federal law prohibit discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, housing, public accommodations and other areas, as proposed in the Equality Act?

questions.support_means: Favors restoring federal preclearance review of voting-rule changes.
questions.text: Should Congress restore federal preclearance review of changes to state and local voting rules, as proposed in the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act?
